name: Cyclophosphamide Anhydrous

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Myelosuppression, Immunosuppression, Bone Marrow Failure and Infections - Severe immunosuppression may lead to serious and sometimes fatal infections. Close hematological monitoring is required. ( 5.1 ) Urinary Tract and Renal Toxicity - Hemorrhagic cystitis, pyelitis, ureteritis, and…

summary: Warnings for Cyclophosphamide Anhydrous include severe weakening of the immune system, which can cause serious and even deadly infections, as well as failure of the bone marrow where blood cells are made [3]. The drug's warnings also list toxicity to the kidneys and urinary tract, such as inflamed or bleeding urinary organs [3]. Additionally, a small computer model, rather than tests in people, estimated low risk scores of 34 for the liver and 39 for the heart [M].
